_README: Step-by-step guide for adding a new showcase entry. JSON does not support real comments, so these underscore-prefixed fields are ignored by the loader. Read these top to bottom before editing the items[] array below.
_STEP_1_DROP_THE_FOLDER: Put your website folder inside /showcase/ in the project root.
If the project arrived as a .zip:  right-click -> Extract All, then move the unzipped folder here.
Folder name = the slug. Use lowercase-with-dashes (good: my-cafe-site / bad: My Cafe Site).
_STEP_2_REQUIRED_FILES_INSIDE_THE_FOLDER: index.html  (REQUIRED — must sit directly inside the folder, not nested deeper)
any other assets the site needs (css/, js/, images/, fonts/, ...)
preview.jpg  (OPTIONAL — 1200x630 thumbnail. If missing, a gradient fallback is shown.)
_STEP_3_OPTIONAL_PROTECT_THE_DEMO: To deter casual right-click / F12 / view-source on a demo, add this line right before </body> in the demo's index.html:

WARNING: This is theatre. The browser must download source to render the page, so a determined visitor can still get the code via the Network tab or 'view-source:' URL prefix. Don't rely on it for real IP protection.
_STEP_4_ADD_AN_ENTRY_BELOW: Copy the example object inside items[] and paste it as a new entry.
slug         -> MUST match the folder name exactly.
title        -> Display title on the card.
category     -> Small label above the title (e.g. 'Landing Page', 'E-commerce', 'Portfolio').
description  -> 1-2 sentence pitch. Shown on the card body.
price        -> Display string. Use any currency. Set to "" or remove to hide.
preview      -> Filename of the thumbnail inside the folder. Leave empty to use the gradient fallback.
tags         -> Array of short tech/style chips (e.g. ["HTML", "CSS", "Responsive"]).
buyUrl       -> Where the Buy button goes. mailto: works fine. Encode spaces as %20.
_STEP_5_SAVE_AND_REFRESH: Open /showcase.html (run a local server first — see _LOCAL_SERVER_NOTE below).
The new card appears automatically — no other file edits needed.
_LOCAL_SERVER_NOTE: fetch() is blocked on file:// in most browsers, so double-clicking showcase.html will show 'Could not load showcase'.
Fix it by serving the folder over http:
Once deployed to real hosting (Netlify / Vercel / GitHub Pages), this caveat goes away.
_TROUBLESHOOTING: Card shows but Open Demo 404s          -> slug doesn't match the folder name (case-sensitive on real hosts).
Thumbnail doesn't show                 -> 'preview' filename wrong, or the file isn't inside that demo's folder.
Manifest fails to load                 -> JSON syntax error. A trailing comma after the last item will break it.
Want to reorder cards                  -> reorder the objects in items[]. They render top-to-bottom in array order.

items.title: Forge — Bookings
items.description: Full appointment booking app: month calendar view with click-to-add, customer database, services catalog, status workflow (Pending → Confirmed → In Progress → Completed), drawer-based day view, Cmd+K search, dark mode, CSV export. Built for salons, repair shops, clinics, home services.

items.title: Forge — Expenses
items.description: Expense tracker with a spending overview, category breakdown, 6-month trend chart, full expense CRUD, custom categories with colour tags, payment-method and date-range filters, reports view, and CSV export. Persists to localStorage — no backend needed.

items.title: Forge — Inventory Suite
items.description: A working inventory management app: full CRUD, low-stock alerts, transaction logs (audit trail), search & filter by SKU/category, Cmd+K command palette, dark mode, CSV import/export. Persists to localStorage — no backend needed.
